description:
Transform rectangular portraits into circular avatars using shape operations. 

The presentation 'computing_pioneers.odp' contains three rectangular photos on Slide 2. Your goal is to mask each photo into a circle.

For each photo:
1. Draw a circle that covers the face.
2. Select the photo and the circle.
3. Use the 'Intersect' command (Shape > Intersect) to crop the image to the circle.

The final result must be three circular portraits on Slide 2. Save the file when done.
